title: Few-Shot Treatment Feasibility Prediction
summary: A thesis project predicting treatment feasibility from MIMIC-IV ICU data using few-shot learning with Symptom Tokens and federated learning. Its tabular SOTA comparison script attempts CTGAN-based data augmentation, falling back from the standalone ctgan package to SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata when the direct import fails.
affiliations: Islamic Azad University, Tehran North Branch
evidence: experiments/exp_tabular_sota.py:328-333 fits sdv's CTGANSynthesizer on metadata and samples synthetic rows as a fallback augmentation method
